output.one_liner: DataForSEO provides APIs for SERP data, app reviews, business data, and market intelligence across search engines and platforms.

auth.notes: API credentials (login:password) sent in Authorization header using HTTP Basic authentication. OAuth 2.0 available as optional wrapper via official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language

access.notes: Free $1 trial credit available to new accounts. Sandbox environment for testing with sample responses. Ongoing use requires pay-as-you-go payment model.

evidence.snippet: You can sign up for free and use your $1 trial credit available to new accounts for trying our APIs
You can also test API integration for free using the DataForSEO Sandbox. The Sandbox provides sample responses for testing
DataForSEO uses a pay-as-you-go pricing model with no subscriptions or recurring fees

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits per endpoint with X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining HTTP headers
